rationale: Diagnosed a massive revenue leak: shed headroom relief was running at priority 2 with a low threshold (>=85) and fireselling goods at >=0.15*base_price before town shop arbitrage (priority 3, cut off after day 25) could capture 2x-3x multipliers. Elevating town shop demand to priority 2, opening its window to days 1-29 with lower cash gating, raising shed headroom threshold to 90 with a 0.50 floor, and introducing crop revenue maximization closes the ~$30k cash gap against champions.
